messages.subject: ctmm fall webinar
parts:
The ctmm fall webinar will take place during the last week in October. You can vote on the schedule here:

https://doodle.com/poll/9rs87i5nsm3pwtax

You can also vote on the content here:

https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/WQNWKZ9

As with previous ctmm webinars, you will need to message/email me your Skype username so that I can add you to the webinar group. "Skype for business" and "Microsoft Teams" are not compatible with Skype's group call feature. There is a 50 participant limit during the webinar.

Best,
Chris

Best,
Chris
